description: This Java source file defines a class 'QRCodeServices' that provides services for generating and verifying QR codes, including handling images with optional logos, and decoding to verify output correctness. The class interacts with external libraries like ZXing for QR code encoding/decoding and integrates with the OFBiz framework for configuration and utility functions.

classes.name: QRCodeServices
classes.description: Contains static methods for generating, processing, and verifying QR codes within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: generateQRCodeImage
methods.description: Generates a QR code image as a BufferedImage based on input parameters including message, size, format, optional logo, and verification. Validates parameters, encodes the message, optionally overlays a logo, and performs output verification.

methods.name: toBufferedImage
methods.description: Converts a ZXing BitMatrix into a BufferedImage, choosing image type based on OS and image format, and renders QR code bits into black and white pixels.

methods.name: createMatrixFromImage
methods.description: Creates a BitMatrix from a BufferedImage by calculating luminance of pixels and setting bits accordingly to represent the QR code.
